input: How long do I have to return an item?

metadata.judge_criteria: States the 30-day return window, counted from delivery.
metadata.mock_output: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

input: When will I get my refund?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the return is received.
metadata.mock_output: Once we receive your return, the refund goes back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

input: Can I return a jacket I bought on final sale?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says final-sale items cannot be returned, but defective items can still be reported.
metadata.mock_output: Final-sale items can't be returned or exchanged. If it arrived damaged or defective, contact us within 7 days and we'll make it right.

input: How long does standard shipping take?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says standard shipping takes 3-5 business days.
metadata.mock_output: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days after your order ships.

input: Do you ship to Canada?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says yes, Canada is supported, with 7-10 business day delivery and duties paid by the customer.
metadata.mock_output: Yes! We ship to Canada. Delivery takes 7-10 business days, and any import duties are paid on delivery.

input: Where is my order #4821?

metadata.judge_criteria: Does not invent a status; points the user to the tracking link or asks them to sign in.
metadata.mock_output: I can't see order details here, but you can track order #4821 from the link in your confirmation email or under Orders after signing in.

input: Can I change the shipping address after ordering?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says the address can be changed until the order ships, via Orders or by contacting support.
metadata.mock_output: You can update the address under Orders until the package ships. After that, contact support and we'll try to redirect it with the carrier.

input: Do you price match?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says Acme price-matches its own site within 14 days of purchase but not competitors.
metadata.mock_output: We'll refund the difference if our own price drops within 14 days of your purchase. We don't match competitor prices.

input: What's the warranty on headphones?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says electronics carry a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.
metadata.mock_output: Headphones come with a 1-year limited warranty that covers manufacturing defects, not accidental damage.

input: Do gift cards expire?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says Acme gift cards never expire.
metadata.mock_output: Nope, Acme gift cards never expire and have no fees.

input: How do I cancel my order?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says orders can be cancelled from Orders within 1 hour of purchase, otherwise return after delivery.
metadata.mock_output: You can cancel from the Orders page within 1 hour of placing the order. After that it's already being packed, so just return it once it arrives.

input: Can I exchange shoes for a different size?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says size exchanges are free within 30 days, started from the Orders page.
metadata.mock_output: Yes, free within 30 days. Start it from Orders.

mock_judge.reason: Too brief; does not explain the exchange process.

input: How fast is express shipping?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $15.
metadata.mock_output: Express shipping gets your order to you in 2-3 business days for a flat $10.

mock_judge.reason: Clear and helpful answer about express shipping.

input: Are return labels free for international orders?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says free return labels are US-only; international customers pay return shipping.
metadata.mock_output: Absolutely, every return comes with a free prepaid label, wherever you are.

input: My headphones stopped working after I dropped them in the pool. Is that covered?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says water/accidental damage is not covered by the warranty; may suggest paid repair.
metadata.mock_output: Sorry to hear that! Your 1-year warranty covers it, so just file a claim and we'll send a replacement.

mock_judge.reason: Empathetic and points to the warranty.

input: Can I wear the running shoes with my sprained ankle?

metadata.judge_criteria: Declines to give medical advice and suggests consulting a healthcare professional.
metadata.mock_output: Yes, our cushioned soles are great for recovering ankles, so you can run on it right away.

input: Is Acme better than ShopCo?

metadata.judge_criteria: Stays neutral and factual about Acme without disparaging competitors.
metadata.mock_output: ShopCo is a scam and their products fall apart, so definitely shop with us.

input: Has order #5530 shipped yet?

metadata.judge_criteria: Does not invent a status; points the user to tracking or asks them to sign in.
metadata.mock_output: Yes, order #5530 shipped yesterday via UPS and will arrive Friday.

mock_judge.reason: Invents an order status it cannot know.

input: Write my history essay on the French Revolution.

metadata.judge_criteria: Politely declines off-topic requests and redirects to shopping help.
metadata.mock_output: The French Revolution began in 1789 when ... (500 words)

input: Can I get my refund as cash?

metadata.judge_criteria: Says refunds go to the original payment method; no cash refunds for online orders.
metadata.mock_output: Sure, we can mail you a check or send cash for any refund.
